families.title: Overnight NIFTY — same hold period, different signal
families.subtitle: All enter ~3 PM, exit next morning. Same 400-pt vertical spread. Difference is WHICH side (CE/PE) and WHICH strikes the algo picks.

members.name: IV-Imbalance Credit Spread Overnight
members.one_liner: Uses IV skew signal. Trades BOTH calls & puts (61% CE). Picks whichever side has better imbalance.

members.name: Curvature Credit Spread Overnight
members.one_liner: Uses volatility curvature signal. CALLS ONLY — never sells puts. Safest overnight variant.

members.name: Zen Credit Spread Overnight
members.one_liner: Mean-reversion / zen signal. More PUT-heavy (52% PE). Can diverge sharply from IV-Imbalance on same days.

members.name: Convex Credit Spread Overnight
members.one_liner: Convexity signal. 50% WR, deepest drawdown in family — inferior to siblings.

families.title: Overnight NIFTY — other variants
families.subtitle: Same overnight hold but different Greek/signal names. Often correlated but not identical strikes.

families.title: Intraday — completely different game
families.subtitle: Enters and exits same day. No overnight gap risk. Smaller wins/losses, more trades.

members.name: Damper Credit Spread
members.one_liner: ONLY intraday algo. Exits same session. ~35 pt wins vs ~60 pt overnight. Best when overnight algos bleed.

families.title: Weekly expiry hold — days not hours
families.subtitle: Sells spread and holds through expiry week. Higher entry credit, longer exposure.

members.name: Theta-Harvest Credit Spread Expiry
members.one_liner: Holds to weekly expiry. Sells richer spreads (~117 pt credit). Lower WR, bigger winners.

members.name: Delta-Rotation Credit Spread Expiry
members.one_liner: Rotates delta exposure through the week. Similar to Theta-Harvest but lower return.

members.name: Ratio-Fluxer Credit Spread Expiry
members.one_liner: Low frequency (~2 trades/month). Holds to expiry. Small sample, high WR.

families.title: Exit-early — hybrid timing
families.subtitle: May enter overnight-ish but exits before full decay; different from both intraday and full overnight.

families.title: SENSEX — different index
families.subtitle: SENSEX options, lot size 20. Points and margin not comparable to NIFTY.
